annotations.title: Start a tenancy application for a rental (link)

description: For someone who wants to rent a specific OpenMoov listing (property_id from search_properties): checks the listing is to let and still available, and returns the link to the application form. Creates nothing — the applicant signs in and completes the application (and its consent to referencing) themselves; never collect their employment, income or ID details in conversation. Use book_viewing first if they have not seen the property.

property_id.description: Property id of a listing to let
